instruction: You are given two input files `/home/user/Desktop/job_a.py` and `/home/user/Desktop/job_b.py`. Complete automated multi-job management and comparison reporting: 1. Write automation script `/home/user/Desktop/run_pipeline.py` (or shell script): - Run `job_a` and `job_b` in serial - Ensure each script outputs its own XDMF result file - Monitor completion by checking generated files 2. Write post-processing script `/home/user/Desktop/compare.py`: - Read displacement fields from `job_a.xdmf` and `job_b.xdmf` - Extract each job's maximum Mises stress and free-end `UY` - Compute ratios: `job_b / job_a` 3. Generate comparison report `/home/user/Desktop/comparison_report.txt` in this format: `Job, Max_Mises, Tip_UY` `job_a, xx, xx` `job_b, xx, xx` `Ratio_Mises, xx` `Ratio_Displacement, xx` [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where dolfinx is installed (e.g. `import dolfinx`).
